cohort: Hospitalized women within 1 week after delivery at Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University, China, from January 2006 to December 2016
finding: Preeclampsia/eclampsia and postpartum hemorrhage were identified as independent risk factors for early VTE during the puerperal period.
mod_finding: This study matched patients on delivery mode, but did not examine mode of delivery as an outcome or a predictor of other outcomes.
